body:

- Surprise or changed understanding: (1) my own placeholder-rewrite friction (n3-2) — the convention was known and still missed at the write moment; mechanical support beats vigilance; (2) "both loops settled" undercounts at this repo — thread-RESOLUTION is a third, GraphQL-only loop (caught by the Director on #169, applied by me on #174 unprompted); (3) the disassembly choreography is shape-independent: peer-agreed and owner-directed contractions ran identically.
- Blockers or risks: none. #174 expected green (docs-only; prior head 7/7). Director asks: set handoff_record_path on be2de6b4 + my eef identity row at your next continuity commit.
